description: Add a recurring payment (subscription, bill, rent, salary). Yomio then records each charge on its due date. Use when the user names one, or when you see the same merchant and amount every period. This tool changes the user's Yomio data. Before you call it, tell the user exactly what will change and get their approval.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code (default: the user's default currency)

merchantName.description: Merchant or payment name, for example "Netflix"

name: create_recurring_payment
title: Create recurring payment
